producthunt.name: Hemory
producthunt.tagline: Keep listening. Searchable memory for your AI agents.
producthunt.description: Hemory comes from Hear + Memory. It's not meeting transcription: Hemory listens on the phone or Apple Watch you already own, and keeps every conversation as memory. Your day is auto-split into moments with speaker labels, then settles into a private, searchable memory. Connect it to Claude, Codex, Cursor, or any agent over MCP, and your AI finally has real context to revisit what you heard and build on it.

producthunt.description: A new roleplay experience. Build characters and entire AI societies with memory, personality and voice that recognize players, form relationships and react to everything around them. Live on Poland's largest roleplay server. Now, add it to yours.

producthunt.name: WZRD
producthunt.tagline: AI-native documents, slides, forms and sheets that talk back
producthunt.description: WZRD is for teams and creators working with documents, slides, forms and sheets. Upload existing work or create from a prompt, then turn it into an AI experience users can engage with. Forms collect answers by speaking or typing. Sheets explain numbers out loud. Slides walk people through the story. Documents engage every user. The output stays conversational and responsive.
